indicators.red_flag: Coordinated near-identical wires to same dest
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.section: ML/TF indicators involving wire transfers (including electronic funds transfers)
indicators.flag: Client attempts to specify the routing of an international wire transfer.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.section: ML/TF indicators involving wire transfers (including electronic funds transfers)
indicators.flag: Client conducts wire transfers that do not include theirs or the beneficiary's requisite information.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.section: ML/TF indicators involving wire transfers (including electronic funds transfers)
indicators.flag: Client utilizes structured cash transactions to send wire transfers in an effort to avoid record keeping requirements.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C4 (Structuring / sub-threshold & reporting-trigger evasion).

indicators.section: ML/TF indicators involving wire transfers (including electronic funds transfers)
indicators.flag: Multiple clients have sent wire transfers over a short period of time to the same recipient.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.section: ML/TF indicators involving wire transfers (including electronic funds transfers)
indicators.flag: Large and/or frequent wire transfers between senders and receivers with no apparent relationship.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.section: ML/TF indicators involving wire transfers (including electronic funds transfers)
indicators.flag: Client sending to, or receiving wire transfers from, multiple clients.
indicators.red_flag: One client fan-in / fan-out to many
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.section: ML/TF indicators related to transactions that involve non-Canadian jurisdictions
indicators.flag: Transactions with jurisdictions that are known to produce or transit drugs or precursor chemicals, or are sources of other types of criminality.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.section: ML/TF indicators related to transactions that involve non-Canadian jurisdictions
indicators.flag: Transactions with jurisdictions that are known to be at a higher risk of ML/TF.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.section: ML/TF indicators related to transactions that involve non-Canadian jurisdictions
indicators.flag: Transaction/business activity involving locations of concern, which can include jurisdictions where there are ongoing conflicts (and periphery areas), countries with weak ML/TF controls, or countries with highly secretive banking or other transactional laws such as transfer limits set by a government.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.section: ML/TF indicators related to transactions that involve non-Canadian jurisdictions
indicators.flag: Transactions involving any countries deemed high risk or non-cooperative by the Financial Action Task Force.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.section: ML/TF indicators related to transactions that involve non-Canadian jurisdictions
indicators.flag: Client makes frequent overseas transfers, not in line with their financial profile.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.section: ML/TF indicators related to the use of other parties — Use of third party
indicators.flag: A client conducts transaction(s) while accompanied, overseen or directed by another party.
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C16 (Third-party / nominee funding & legal-professional channel detection); data D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data).

indicators.section: ML/TF indicators related to the use of other parties — Use of third party
indicators.flag: Wire transfers to or from unrelated parties (foreign or domestic).
indicators.red_flag: Wires to / from unrelated third parties
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C16 (Third-party / nominee funding & legal-professional channel detection); data D3 (Wire / ACH / EFT & cross-border payment data (incl. EMT, P2P, remittance)).

indicators.section: ML/TF indicators related to the use of other parties — Use of third party
indicators.flag: Client appears to be or states they are acting on behalf of another party.
indicators.red_flag: Client acting on behalf of another (nominee)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C16 (Third-party / nominee funding & legal-professional channel detection); data D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data).

indicators.section: ML/TF indicators related to the use of other parties — Use of nominee
indicators.flag: Client is involved in transactions that are suspicious but refuses or is unable to answer questions related to the transactions.
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C16 (Third-party / nominee funding & legal-professional channel detection); data D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data).

indicators.section: ML/TF indicators related to the use of other parties — Use of gatekeeper
indicators.flag: Gatekeeper avoids identifying their client or disclosing their client's identity when such identification would be normal during the course of a transaction.
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C16 (Third-party / nominee funding & legal-professional channel detection); D19 (Legal/notary trust-account & third-party-funding data) insufficient → monitor.

indicators.section: ML/TF indicators related to the use of other parties — Use of gatekeeper
indicators.flag: Gatekeeper is willing to pay higher fees and seeks to conduct the transaction quickly when there is no apparent need for such expediency.
indicators.red_flag: Gatekeeper pays premium for unexplained speed
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C16 (Third-party / nominee funding & legal-professional channel detection); D19 (Legal/notary trust-account & third-party-funding data) insufficient → monitor.

indicators.section: ML/TF indicators related to the use of other parties — Use of gatekeeper
indicators.flag: Gatekeeper is processing transactions not typical of their business (e.g. excessive amount of cash, payment to non-clients or parties of transactions).
indicators.red_flag: Gatekeeper processing atypical cash / non-client payments
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C16 (Third-party / nominee funding & legal-professional channel detection); D19 (Legal/notary trust-account & third-party-funding data) insufficient → monitor.

indicators.section: ML indicators related to bribery and corruption — High-risk jurisdictions for corruption
indicators.flag: A client operates in, or is related to companies operating in, jurisdictions identified as high-risk for corruption.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.section: ML indicators related to bribery and corruption — High-risk industries for bribery
indicators.flag: A client operates in a high-risk industry for bribery, particularly those requiring government authorizations or licenses.
indicators.rationale: Gap; buildable now with C8 (Income / occupation-vs-activity profile-inconsistency detection) on D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data).

build_logic.logic: Flag a personal account whose inflow volume or wealth velocity is inconsistent with the customer's declared income, occupation, or stated source of funds, escalating when large credits lack a plausible origin for the customer's profile.
build_logic.window: rolling 90 days vs declared income profile
build_logic.source: personal deposit ledger joined to onboarding income/occupation KYC data
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review gate

indicators.section: ML indicators related to bribery and corruption — Politically exposed domestic or foreign persons
indicators.flag: A client is a politically exposed foreign person operating in a high-risk jurisdiction where they are responsible for granting authorizations, licenses, or contracts to businesses.
indicators.red_flag: PEP controlling licensing in high-risk jurisdiction
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C17 (PEP & sanctioned-elite proxy screening).

indicators.section: ML indicators related to bribery and corruption — Politically exposed domestic or foreign persons
indicators.flag: A client is a family member or known associate of a politically exposed foreign person.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C17 (PEP & sanctioned-elite proxy screening).

indicators.section: ML indicators related to bribery and corruption — Politically exposed domestic or foreign persons
indicators.flag: A client engages in high-value transactions with politically exposed domestic or foreign persons, including their family members or known associates.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C17 (PEP & sanctioned-elite proxy screening).

indicators.section: ML indicators related to bribery and corruption — Opaque long-term government contracts
indicators.flag: Transactions involving long-term government contracts that may have been awarded through an opaque selection process to a legal entity or multiple legal entities with similar [beneficial owners.](/guidance-directives/glossary-glossaire/1-eng#bo)
indicators.red_flag: Opaque gov-contract award to co-owned entities
indicators.rationale: Gap; buildable now with C15 (Beneficial-ownership, shell / front-company & nominee network analysis) on D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data).

build_logic.logic: Flag an entity exhibiting shell or front-company markers â opaque or circular beneficial ownership, shared registered addresses or directors, recent incorporation with no observable operations â escalating when nominees or addresses recur across a cluster of related entities.
build_logic.window: rolling 90 days over the ownership/address graph
build_logic.source: corporate registry + KYC beneficial-ownership records + entity-resolution graph
build_logic.route: Tier-2 network alert â AML investigations gate

indicators.section: ML indicators related to bribery and corruption — Services provided to state-owned entities in high-risk jurisdictions for corruption
indicators.flag: Transactions involving services provided to state-owned companies or public institutions by companies registered in [high-risk jurisdictions for corruption](#z1).
indicators.red_flag: Services to SOE from high-corruption-jurisdiction firm
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.section: ML indicators related to bribery and corruption — Government business conducted through personal accounts
indicators.flag: Transactions involving government business being conducted through personal accounts, which may indicate an attempt to divert or misuse public funds.
indicators.rationale: Gap; buildable now with C7 (Peer / business-activity anomaly (revenue-vs-operations) detection) on D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data).

build_logic.logic: Flag a business account whose transaction inflows are disproportionate to its declared revenue, headcount, payroll, or operating-expense footprint relative to industry peers, escalating when revenue appears decoupled from any observable operational activity.
build_logic.window: rolling 90 days vs declared profile and peer cohort
build_logic.source: business deposit ledger joined to KYC business profile + industry peer benchmarks
build_logic.route: Tier-2 alert â AML analyst review gate

indicators.rationale: Gap; buildable now with C15 (Beneficial-ownership, shell / front-company & nominee network analysis) on D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data).

build_logic.logic: Flag an entity exhibiting shell or front-company markers â opaque or circular beneficial ownership, shared registered addresses or directors, recent incorporation with no observable operations â escalating when nominees or addresses recur across a cluster of related entities.
build_logic.window: rolling 90 days over the ownership/address graph

indicators.flag: Would not typically be involved in the client’s industry or line of business.
indicators.rationale: Gap; buildable now with C15 (Beneficial-ownership, shell / front-company & nominee network analysis) on D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data).

build_logic.logic: Flag an entity exhibiting shell or front-company markers â opaque or circular beneficial ownership, shared registered addresses or directors, recent incorporation with no observable operations â escalating when nominees or addresses recur across a cluster of related entities.
build_logic.window: rolling 90 days over the ownership/address graph
build_logic.source: corporate registry + KYC beneficial-ownership records + entity-resolution graph

indicators.flag: A client makes high-value payments for services, such as consulting fees, in [jurisdictions identified as high-risk for corruption](#z1).
indicators.red_flag: High-value consulting fees to corruption haven

indicators.section: ML indicators related to bribery and corruption — Commission payments to offshore bank accounts

indicators.rationale: Gap; buildable now with C15 (Beneficial-ownership, shell / front-company & nominee network analysis) on D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data).

build_logic.logic: Flag an entity exhibiting shell or front-company markers â opaque or circular beneficial ownership, shared registered addresses or directors, recent incorporation with no observable operations â escalating when nominees or addresses recur across a cluster of related entities.
build_logic.window: rolling 90 days over the ownership/address graph

indicators.section: ML indicators related to bribery and corruption — Funds routed through intermediaries in unrelated countries
indicators.flag: Funds move through intermediaries in third countries or through countries with which the client does not appear to have any legitimate business or personal ties.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.section: ML indicators related to bribery and corruption — Use of third parties or legal entities to obscure ownership
indicators.flag: A client uses intermediaries, professional facilitators, or complex legal entity structures to hide the origin or ownership of funds.
indicators.rationale: Gap; buildable now with C15 (Beneficial-ownership, shell / front-company & nominee network analysis) on D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data).

build_logic.logic: Flag an entity exhibiting shell or front-company markers â opaque or circular beneficial ownership, shared registered addresses or directors, recent incorporation with no observable operations â escalating when nominees or addresses recur across a cluster of related entities.
build_logic.window: rolling 90 days over the ownership/address graph
build_logic.source: corporate registry + KYC beneficial-ownership records + entity-resolution graph

indicators.section: ML indicators related to bribery and corruption — Transactions with vague or fraudulent documentation
indicators.flag: Vague or incomplete payment details.
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C22 (Trade-based money-laundering & documentary anomaly detection); data D15 (Trade-finance / customs / shipping & logistics data).

indicators.section: ML indicators related to bribery and corruption — Transactions with vague or fraudulent documentation
indicators.flag: Fraudulent documentation used to justify the transfer of funds.
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C22 (Trade-based money-laundering & documentary anomaly detection); data D15 (Trade-finance / customs / shipping & logistics data).

indicators.section: Indicators related to domestic and foreign politically exposed persons — Unexplained growth in net worth
indicators.flag: A client who is a politically exposed domestic or foreign person exhibits a significant increase in net worth that cannot be reasonably explained by their reported income, assets, or legitimate sources of wealth.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C17 (PEP & sanctioned-elite proxy screening).

indicators.section: Indicators related to domestic and foreign politically exposed persons — Connections to politically exposed foreign persons
indicators.flag: A client employs or has business connections with a politically exposed foreign person, or their family members or close associates.
indicators.red_flag: Business connection to foreign PEP / associates
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C17 (PEP & sanctioned-elite proxy screening).

indicators.section: Indicators related to domestic and foreign politically exposed persons — Payments for travel and lodging of politically exposed domestic or foreign persons
indicators.flag: Payments are made for the travel and lodging of politically exposed domestic or foreign persons, or their family members, which may indicate attempts to curry favor or provide undue benefits.
indicators.red_flag: Travel / lodging paid for PEP (undue benefit)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C17 (PEP & sanctioned-elite proxy screening).

indicators.section: Indicators related to domestic and foreign politically exposed persons — High-value asset transactions
indicators.flag: Transactions involving politically exposed domestic or foreign persons related to the acquisition of high-value assets, such as real estate, luxury vehicles, or other luxury goods, that are:
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C17 (PEP & sanctioned-elite proxy screening).

indicators.section: Indicators related to domestic and foreign politically exposed persons — High-value asset transactions
indicators.flag: Inconsistent with the client’s reported source of wealth.
indicators.red_flag: PEP asset buy inconsistent with source of wealth
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C17 (PEP & sanctioned-elite proxy screening).

indicators.section: Indicators related to domestic and foreign politically exposed persons — High-value asset transactions
indicators.flag: Outside the individual’s normal pattern of activity or lifestyle.
indicators.red_flag: PEP asset buy outside normal lifestyle
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C17 (PEP & sanctioned-elite proxy screening).

indicators.section: Indicators related to domestic and foreign politically exposed persons — Ownership of entities with little or no commercial purpose
indicators.flag: A client who is a politically exposed domestic or foreign person owns or controls a legal entity, particularly one located offshore, which appears to serve little or no legitimate commercial purpose.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C17 (PEP & sanctioned-elite proxy screening).

indicators.section: Indicators related to domestic and foreign politically exposed persons — Assets held in the names of intermediate legal entities
indicators.flag: Assets are held in the name of legal entities whose beneficial owners are tied to a politically exposed domestic or foreign person, their family members, or close associates.
indicators.red_flag: PEP assets held via intermediate entities
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C17 (PEP & sanctioned-elite proxy screening).

indicators.section: Indicators related to domestic and foreign politically exposed persons — Use of multiple bank accounts without commercial justification
indicators.flag: A client who is a politically exposed domestic or foreign person maintains multiple bank accounts, particularly when there is no apparent commercial or legitimate reason for doing so.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C17 (PEP & sanctioned-elite proxy screening).

indicators.section: Indicators related to domestic and foreign politically exposed persons — Suspicious transaction patterns inconsistent with the client’s profile
indicators.flag: Multiple cash deposits into their account.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C17 (PEP & sanctioned-elite proxy screening).

indicators.section: Indicators related to domestic and foreign politically exposed persons — Suspicious transaction patterns inconsistent with the client’s profile
indicators.flag: Multiple electronic funds transfers from different senders within a short time frame.
indicators.red_flag: PEP EFT fan-in from many senders

indicators.section: Indicators related to domestic and foreign politically exposed persons — Suspicious transaction patterns inconsistent with the client’s profile
indicators.flag: Situations where the politically exposed person is both the ordering and beneficiary client for electronic funds transfers.
indicators.red_flag: PEP both ordering and beneficiary of EFT
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C17 (PEP & sanctioned-elite proxy screening).

indicators.flag: Transactions involving certain high-risk jurisdictions such as locations in the midst of or in proximity to, armed conflict where terrorist groups operate or locations which are subject to weaker ML/TF controls.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.section: Indicators specifically related to TF
indicators.flag: Transactions in the name of an entity, a foundation or association, which may be linked or involved with a suspected terrorist organization.

indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence intelligence).

indicators.section: Indicators specifically related to TF

indicators.red_flag: Counterparty on terror sanctions / media list
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C18 (Sanctions / watchlist screening).

indicators.section: Indicators specifically related to TF
indicators.flag: Law enforcement information provided which indicates persons or entities may be linked to a terrorist organization or terrorist activities.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C18 (Sanctions / watchlist screening).

indicators.section: Indicators specifically related to TF
indicators.flag: Client conducted travel-related purchases (e.g. purchase of airline tickets, travel visa, passport, etc.) linked to high-risk jurisdictions (including cities or districts of concern), specifically countries (and adjacent countries) under conflict and/or political instability or known to support terrorist activities and organizations.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.section: Indicators specifically related to TF
indicators.flag: Person or entity's online presence supports violent extremism or radicalization.
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence intelligence).

indicators.section: Indicators specifically related to TF
indicators.flag: Client donates to a cause that is subject to derogatory information that is publicly available (e.g. crowdfunding initiative, charity, NPO, NGO, etc.).
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence intelligence).
